summary: The file changed during review: it is now v0.3 (sha256 2b369018...8a56), not the hash given. Two blockers: v0.3 still states facts that are false (no P2 index, a guard that does not exist, "no rule changed"), and it drops TabPFN as "not installed" although it is installed and mandatory. Lead rulings needed: one label depth rule (as built; 15-19 % of national turbidity label rows include a sample deeper than 1 m); distillation masked on M2 Test-S chips; a no-KD twin for slots 7-8; train_p2 rows kept out of national held-out blocks; P2 floor stands (38 water bodies), so P2 is descriptive. No test_p2 value was read; lock and index hashes verify.
